fullDescription: A warm, playful pastel button system on cream paper: every variant, size and state as soft, fully-rounded buttons with a springy press, sky + coral accents and Poppins, framed as one Button Studio canvas.
prompt:
## Resumo
A warm, playful button-system showcase page rendered in soft pastels on cream paper, framed as a single 'Button Studio' canvas. A blurred sticky cream nav (a sky-to-coral gradient rounded logo tile with a cursor-click icon, a 'ButtonStudio' wordmark, four anchor links with an animated underline, a ghost 'Docs' button and a small solid sky 'Copy prompt' button) sits over a full-bleed hero with a faint dotted-grid backdrop and three big blurred floating color blobs (sky, coral, amber). The hero centers an eyebrow pill ('A playful, rounded button system'), a huge extrabold headline 'Buttons that feel delightful to press.' where 'delightful' is a sky-to-coral gradient word underlined by a hand-drawn coral squiggle SVG, a muted subhead, a candy-gradient + outline CTA pair, and a rounded white palette card showing four color chips (cream / sky / coral / ink) and a 'Cream / Sky / Coral / Poppins' caption. The body is a showcase canvas of rounded white demo cards with an icon-tile + numbered title + count-pill header: 01 Variants (a wrap of six labelled buttons: Primary sky, Accent coral, Soft tint, Outline, Ghost, Candy gradient), then a two-up row of 02 Sizes (sm/md/lg) and 03 States (default, pressed-pushed-in, loading spinner, disabled), then 04 Icon & Group (leading icon, trailing icon, icon-only circle, coral FAB, and a pill segmented Day/Week/Month group). It closes on a full-bleed candy-gradient CTA band (sky-700 to rose-600, white blobs) with a white 'Copy the prompt' button and a dark-ink 'See it live' button, then a minimal cream footer with the brand cluster and three social icons.

## Estilo Visual
Build a warm, playful, fully ROUNDED button system on cream paper. Define the palette exactly via Tailwind config extend.colors: cream #fdf9f3 (page bg, body background:#fdf9f3), sky #38bdf8 (decorative accent only, used for blobs/rings/underline/selection), skyfill #0369a1 (sky-700, the accessible fill for sky buttons + brand text, white text 5.4:1), coral #fb7185 (decorative accent only), coralfill #e11d48 (rose-600, accessible coral fill, white text 4.7:1), ink #3b3a4a (primary text), mute #6b6a78 (>=4.5:1 muted body text). Selection is background #38bdf8 / white. Font: Poppins (Google Fonts, weights 400;500;600;700;800) as the only family (sans: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui); headlines font-extrabold (800) tracking-tight, buttons/labels font-semibold (600). Every button is a pill: base class .b = font-weight 600, border-radius 9999px, inline-flex items-center gap .5rem, line-height 1, cursor pointer, will-change transform, and a springy transition: transform .18s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow .18s ease, background .18s ease, color .18s ease. Focus-visible = 3px solid rgba(2,132,199,.65) outline, offset 3px. Define custom boxShadows: soft '0 10px 30px -12px rgba(56,189,248,0.35)', coralsoft '0 10px 30px -12px rgba(251,113,133,0.40)', card '0 24px 60px -28px rgba(59,58,74,0.28)', btn '0 6px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.06)'. Add a dotted backdrop utility .dotgrid = radial-gradient(rgba(59,58,74,0.07) 1.4px, transparent 1.4px) at background-size 22px 22px, a .blob utility = filter blur(64px), and two float keyframes (.float-a 6s, .float-b 8s reverse, translateY 0 -> -14px). Cards are white, rounded-[2rem], shadow-card, ring-1 ring-ink/5 with a .tile hover lift (translateY -4px + deeper shadow). Keep everything soft, bouncy, airy and pastel: the whole language is 'buttons that feel delightful to press', motion + roundness + warm color carrying the personality, with darkened accent fills guaranteeing contrast.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky blurred nav
A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) whose inner bar is backdrop-blur-md bg-cream/80 with a bottom border-ink/5. Inside a mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 -> sm:px-8 row, h-16, items-center justified-between: LEFT = a brand link (gap-2.5), a 36px (w-9 h-9) rounded-2xl tile with a bg-gradient-to-br from-sky to-coral, white text and shadow-soft holding an Iconify ph:cursor-click-bold icon, then a 1.05rem font-extrabold tracking-tight wordmark 'Button' + 'Studio' where 'Studio' is text-skyfill; CENTER (hidden below md, gap-7, 14px font-medium text-mute) = four .navlink anchors 'Variants / Sizes / States / Icon & Group' that get an animated sky underline (an ::after bar growing 0 -> 100% width on hover) and darken to text-ink; RIGHT (gap-2.5) = a ghost small button 'Docs' (hidden on the smallest screens) and a solid sky small button 'Copy prompt' with a leading ph:sparkle-fill icon.

### Hero
A relative overflow-hidden full-bleed section. Background layers: an absolute inset-0 .dotgrid at opacity-90, plus three big blurred floating blobs, a w-80 h-80 bg-sky/20 .float-a top-left, a w-80 h-80 bg-coral/18 .float-b top-right, and a w-72 h-72 bg-amber-200/25 .float-a bottom-center. In a relative mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 -> sm:px-8, pt-16 pb-14 -> sm:pt-20 sm:pb-20, text-center column: an eyebrow pill (inline-flex rounded-full bg-white/70 px-4 py-1.5, 12px font-semibold text-skyfill, shadow-sm, ring-1 ring-sky/20) with a ph:palette-fill icon + 'A playful, rounded button system'; a mt-6 text-4xl -> sm:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.05] h1 reading 'Buttons that feel delightful to press.' where 'delightful' is a whitespace-nowrap span with a bg-gradient-to-r from-sky to-coral bg-clip-text text-transparent fill AND a hand-drawn coral (#fb7185) squiggle SVG underline (a curved <path>, stroke-width 4, stroke-linecap round) absolutely positioned -bottom-2 across its width; a mt-7 max-w-xl text-base -> sm:text-lg text-mute subhead 'A full button design system on one canvas: every variant, size, and state, rendered soft and bouncy. Pick a button, copy the prompt, drop it in your product.'; a mt-9 flex-wrap justify-center gap-3 CTA pair, a candy-gradient LG button 'Explore the system' (leading ph:cursor-click-fill) and an outline LG button 'Copy all prompts' (leading ph:copy-bold); then a mt-12 inline-flex palette card (rounded-3xl bg-white/70 px-6 py-4 shadow-card ring-1 ring-ink/5) holding an uppercase 'Palette' caption, four 34px rounded-[12px] .chip swatches (cream w/ ring, sky, coral, ink), a thin vertical divider, and a 'Cream / Sky / Coral / Poppins' caption.

### Showcase section heading
Open the showcase with a flex-col -> sm:flex-row sm:items-end justified-between row (gap-4, mb-9): LEFT a small uppercase text-skyfill font-semibold eyebrow 'The system' over a text-2xl -> sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight h2 'Button showcase canvas'; RIGHT a max-w-sm 14px text-mute line 'A labeled grid of every button in the kit. Hover any button to feel the lift, the squish, the bounce.'

### Demo card pattern
Every demo block is a .tile rounded-[2rem] bg-white shadow-card ring-1 ring-ink/5 card, p-7 -> sm:p-9, with scroll-mt-24 for anchor offset. Each opens with a header row (flex items-start gap-4 mb-7): a 44px (w-11 h-11) rounded-2xl tinted icon tile (e.g. bg-skyfill/15 text-skyfill, bg-coralfill/15 text-coralfill, bg-amber-200/50 text-amber-700, bg-ink/8 text-ink) holding an Iconify icon, beside an 18px font-bold title prefixed with a two-digit number ('01 · Variants') that carries a small count pill (a rounded-full tinted badge with the item count) and a 14px text-mute one-line description.

### 01 Variants card
A demo card (sky icon tile ph:stack-fill, title '01 · Variants', count pill '6', desc 'Primary, accent, soft, outline, ghost, and a candy gradient for the hero action.'). Body = a flex-wrap items-center gap-x-7 gap-y-6 of six labelled samples, each a flex-col items-center gap-2.5 with a medium (.b-md) button above a tiny text-mute caption: Primary (.b-sky) 'Sky', Accent (.b-coral) 'Coral', Soft tint (.b-soft) 'Sky 100', Outline (.b-out) 'Stroke', Ghost (.b-ghost) 'Minimal', Candy (.b-candy) 'Gradient'. This shows emphasis falling from a solid sky primary through a coral accent, soft tint, outline, ghost, down to the playful candy gradient.

### 02 Sizes + 03 States two-up row
A grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-7 of two demo cards. SIZES (coral icon tile ph:arrows-out-line-vertical-bold, '02 · Sizes', count '3', desc 'Small, medium, large. Padding and radius scale together.') = a flex-wrap items-end gap-5 of three solid sky buttons Small/.b-sm, Medium/.b-md, Large/.b-lg each over a 'sm / md / lg' caption. STATES (amber icon tile ph:pulse-bold, '03 · States', count '4', desc 'Default, pressed, loading, disabled.') = a flex-wrap items-end gap-5 of four samples: Default (.b-sky), Pressed (.b-sky .b-pressed with a ph:hand-pointing-fill icon, captioned 'active · pushed in'), Loading (.b-sky .b-loading with a spinning ph:circle-notch-bold), and Disabled (.b-disabled).

### 04 Icon & Group card
A demo card (ink icon tile ph:squares-four-fill, '04 · Icon & Group', count '5', desc 'Leading icons, icon-only circles, and a joined segmented group.'). Body = a flex-wrap items-center gap-x-7 gap-y-6 of five labelled samples: a coral 'Download' button with a LEADING ph:download-simple-bold ('leading'); a sky 'Continue' button with a TRAILING ph:arrow-right-bold ('trailing'); a soft-tint icon-only circle (.b-soft !rounded-full !p-3, aria-label like) with ph:heart-fill ('icon only'); a coral icon-only circle FAB with ph:plus-bold ('FAB'); and a SEGMENTED group (an inline-flex rounded-full bg-skyfill/15 p-1 bar of three .b-sm buttons, the first solid sky 'Day', then ghost 'Week' and 'Month' in skyfill text) captioned 'segmented group'.

### Candy-gradient CTA band
A full-bleed relative overflow-hidden section with a bg-gradient-to-br from-skyfill to-coralfill (sky-700 -> rose-600, darkened so white text + the secondary button clear 4.5:1 across the whole band), two big blurred white/amber floating blobs behind it. In a relative mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 -> sm:px-8 py-16 -> sm:py-20 text-center text-white column: a text-3xl -> sm:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight h2 'Press it. Ship it. Smile.', a mt-4 max-w-md white line 'Every button on this canvas comes with a copy-paste prompt. Grab the whole system and start building.', and a mt-8 flex-wrap justify-center gap-3 button pair, a LG button bg-white text-coralfill shadow-card 'Copy the prompt' (leading ph:copy-bold) and a LG button bg-ink text-white ring-2 ring-white/70 shadow-card 'See it live' (trailing ph:arrow-up-right-bold).

### Footer
A minimal bg-cream footer, mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 -> sm:px-8 py-10, a flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center justified-between gap-4: LEFT a brand cluster (a 32px rounded-xl from-sky to-coral gradient tile with a ph:cursor-click-bold icon + a font-extrabold 'Button' + 'Studio' wordmark where Studio is text-skyfill); CENTER a 14px text-mute line 'A button design system on the infinite canvas. Built for makers.'; RIGHT a gap-3 row of three text-mute social icon links (ph:github-logo-fill, ph:twitter-logo-fill, ph:figma-logo-fill) that hover to text-sky.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
One base .b every button shares: font-weight 600, border-radius 9999px (full pill), inline-flex items-center gap .5rem, line-height 1, cursor pointer, user-select none, will-change transform, and the signature springy transition transform .18s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) plus .18s ease on box-shadow/background/color. :focus-visible = outline 3px solid rgba(2,132,199,.65) offset 3px. Hover lifts the button translateY(-3px) (candy also rotate(-1deg)); :active squishes to translateY(0) scale(.97). The bounce is the whole personality.

### Componente
Six variants, all using DARKENED accessible accent fills so white text clears AA: .b-sky background #0369a1, white text, shadow 0 10px 22px -8px rgba(3,105,161,.55), hover bg #075985; .b-coral background #e11d48, white text, hover bg #be123c; .b-soft background #e0f4fe with #075985 text, hover bg #cdecfd (a pale sky tint, dark-enough text for >=4.5:1); .b-out transparent with #3b3a4a text and inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(59,58,74,.28) ring, hover ring #0284c7 + text #075985; .b-ghost transparent with #57565f text, hover text #3b3a4a on a rgba(59,58,74,.06) wash; .b-candy a 120deg linear-gradient(#0369a1, #e11d48) with white text (both stops darkened so white text stays >=4.5:1 across the whole band), hover adds a -1deg rotate.

### Componente
.b-sm = padding .55rem 1rem, font-size .8rem; .b-md = padding .8rem 1.5rem, font-size .95rem; .b-lg = padding 1.05rem 2rem, font-size 1.1rem. All stay fully pill-shaped; only padding and type scale.

### Componente
.b-pressed = a pushed-in look that reads in a static frame, transform translateY(2px) scale(.95), background #075985, box-shadow inset 0 4px 10px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.35) + 0 2px 6px -4px rgba(3,105,161,.5). .b-loading = pointer-events none, paired with a .spin element (animation spin .8s linear infinite, @keyframes spin to rotate 360deg) on a ph:circle-notch-bold icon. .b-disabled = background #e3ded5, text #5c5950, no shadow, cursor not-allowed, transform none (a muted warm-gray any variant can wear).

### Componente
Under the gradient hero word 'delightful', an absolutely positioned inline SVG (-bottom-2, full width, preserveAspectRatio none) drawing a single hand-drawn curved <path> in coral #fb7185, stroke-width 4, stroke-linecap round, so the highlight word gets a casual marker underline rather than a straight rule.

### Componente
Icon-only buttons: a .b with !rounded-full !p-3 holding a single Iconify icon, aria-labelled (a soft-tint heart, a coral plus FAB). Segmented group: an inline-flex rounded-full bg-skyfill/15 p-1 bar of three .b-sm buttons, the first a solid sky 'Day' and the rest ghost buttons forced to skyfill text ('Week', 'Month'), the whole pill grouping reading as one toggle control.

### Componente
Each nav link is .navlink with an ::after pseudo bar (position absolute, left 0, bottom -6px, height 2px, width 0, background sky #38bdf8, border-radius 2px, transition width .25s ease) that grows to width 100% on hover, a playful sky underline sweep.

### Componente
.dotgrid = a radial-gradient(rgba(59,58,74,0.07) 1.4px, transparent 1.4px) tiled at 22px 22px behind the hero. .blob = filter blur(64px); big rounded color blobs (sky/20, coral/18, amber-200/25) animate gently with .float-a (6s) and .float-b (8s reverse) keyframes translating translateY 0 -> -14px, so the warm pastel atmosphere drifts behind the content.

## Notas Especiais
A warm, playful, fully ROUNDED (border-radius 9999px) pastel button system on cream paper, the whole personality is bounce + roundness + soft color. Exact palette via Tailwind config: cream #fdf9f3 (page bg), sky #38bdf8 (DECORATIVE accent only, blobs/rings/underline/selection), skyfill #0369a1 (sky-700, accessible fill for sky buttons + brand text, white text 5.4:1), coral #fb7185 (decorative accent only), coralfill #e11d48 (rose-600, accessible coral fill, white text 4.7:1), ink #3b3a4a (text), mute #6b6a78 (muted body, >=4.5:1). Soft variant = bg #e0f4fe / #075985 text; disabled = bg #e3ded5 / #5c5950 text. Candy gradient = 120deg linear-gradient(#0369a1, #e11d48) (both stops darkened so white text clears AA). Custom shadows: card 0 24px 60px -28px rgba(59,58,74,0.28), soft 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(56,189,248,0.35), coralsoft 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(251,113,133,0.40). Font: Poppins ONLY (Google Fonts 400;500;600;700;800), extrabold headlines + tracking-tight, semibold buttons/labels. Signature motion: springy transition cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), hover translateY(-3px) (candy also rotate(-1deg)), active scale(.97); static .b-pressed pushes in with an inset shadow; .spin loader at .8s. Icons are Iconify ph (phosphor) loaded from code.iconify.design (cursor-click-bold/-fill, sparkle-fill, palette-fill, stack-fill, arrows-out-line-vertical-bold, pulse-bold, hand-pointing-fill, circle-notch-bold, squares-four-fill, download-simple-bold, arrow-right-bold, heart-fill, plus-bold, copy-bold, arrow-up-right-bold, github/twitter/figma-logo-fill). To transfer the STYLE keep the cream+sky+coral pastel palette with darkened accent FILLS for contrast, the full-pill radius, Poppins, the springy bounce/lift/squish motion, the dotted-grid + floating-blob backdrop, the white rounded-[2rem] shadow-card tiles, and the hand-drawn squiggle underline. To transfer the LAYOUT keep the single marketing canvas (sticky blurred nav -> blobby dotted hero with palette chip card -> showcase cards 01 Variants / 02 Sizes + 03 States two-up / 04 Icon & Group, each with an icon-tile + numbered title + count-pill header -> candy-gradient CTA band -> minimal footer) and the labelled 'button above a caption' demo grids. No em-dashes in any copy.

style.description: A soft, friendly, 'bouncy' aesthetic, all pastel and rounded, that makes buttons feel delightful to press. The palette is warm cream paper with two playful accents, sky blue and coral pink, plus a soft ink for text, and every interactive element is fully pill-shaped (border-radius 9999px) with springy motion. Type is Poppins throughout (extrabold for headlines, semibold for buttons and labels), tight tracking on display sizes. Surfaces are airy: a faint dotted radial-dot grid backdrop, big blurred floating color blobs animating gently behind the hero and CTA, white cards floating on the cream with soft long shadows and 1px ink/5 ring borders, rounded-[2rem] corners on cards and rounded-3xl on the palette chip card. The signature feel is the button motion, a springy cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) transform on hover that lifts the button 3px (the candy variant also rotates -1deg), an active squish to scale(.97), and a static 'pressed' treatment that pushes the button in with an inset shadow. Accents are used decoratively in their bright form (sky #38bdf8, coral #fb7185) but every actual filled button and text-on-color uses a DARKENED accessible form (sky-700 #0369a1, rose-600 #e11d48) so white text always clears WCAG-AA. Hand-drawn touches (a coral squiggle underline SVG under the gradient hero word) and emoji-light iconography keep it warm and human, never corporate.

A demo card (sky icon tile ph:stack-fill, title '01 · Variants', count pill '6', desc 'Primary, accent, soft, outline, ghost, and a candy gradient for the hero action.'). Body = a flex-wrap items-center gap-x-7 gap-y-6 of six labelled samples, each a flex-col items-center gap-2.5 with a medium (.b-md) button above a tiny text-mute caption: Primary (.b-sky) 'Sky', Accent (.b-coral) 'Coral', Soft tint (.b-soft) 'Sky 100', Outline (.b-out) 'Stroke', Ghost (.b-ghost) 'Minimal', Candy (.b-candy) 'Gradient'. This shows emphasis falling from a solid sky primary through a coral accent, soft tint, outline, ghost, down to the playful candy gradient.

A grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-7 of two demo cards. SIZES (coral icon tile ph:arrows-out-line-vertical-bold, '02 · Sizes', count '3', desc 'Small, medium, large. Padding and radius scale together.') = a flex-wrap items-end gap-5 of three solid sky buttons Small/.b-sm, Medium/.b-md, Large/.b-lg each over a 'sm / md / lg' caption. STATES (amber icon tile ph:pulse-bold, '03 · States', count '4', desc 'Default, pressed, loading, disabled.') = a flex-wrap items-end gap-5 of four samples: Default (.b-sky), Pressed (.b-sky .b-pressed with a ph:hand-pointing-fill icon, captioned 'active · pushed in'), Loading (.b-sky .b-loading with a spinning ph:circle-notch-bold), and Disabled (.b-disabled).

A demo card (ink icon tile ph:squares-four-fill, '04 · Icon & Group', count '5', desc 'Leading icons, icon-only circles, and a joined segmented group.'). Body = a flex-wrap items-center gap-x-7 gap-y-6 of five labelled samples: a coral 'Download' button with a LEADING ph:download-simple-bold ('leading'); a sky 'Continue' button with a TRAILING ph:arrow-right-bold ('trailing'); a soft-tint icon-only circle (.b-soft !rounded-full !p-3, aria-label like) with ph:heart-fill ('icon only'); a coral icon-only circle FAB with ph:plus-bold ('FAB'); and a SEGMENTED group (an inline-flex rounded-full bg-skyfill/15 p-1 bar of three .b-sm buttons, the first solid sky 'Day', then ghost 'Week' and 'Month' in skyfill text) captioned 'segmented group'.

prompts.partPt: Candy-gradient Chamada Final para Ação band
prompts.prompt: A full-bleed relative overflow-hidden section with a bg-gradient-to-br from-skyfill to-coralfill (sky-700 -> rose-600, darkened so white text + the secondary button clear 4.5:1 across the whole band), two big blurred white/amber floating blobs behind it. In a relative mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 -> sm:px-8 py-16 -> sm:py-20 text-center text-white column: a text-3xl -> sm:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight h2 'Press it. Ship it. Smile.', a mt-4 max-w-md white line 'Every button on this canvas comes with a copy-paste prompt. Grab the whole system and start building.', and a mt-8 flex-wrap justify-center gap-3 button pair, a LG button bg-white text-coralfill shadow-card 'Copy the prompt' (leading ph:copy-bold) and a LG button bg-ink text-white ring-2 ring-white/70 shadow-card 'See it live' (trailing ph:arrow-up-right-bold).

A minimal bg-cream footer, mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 -> sm:px-8 py-10, a flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center justified-between gap-4: LEFT a brand cluster (a 32px rounded-xl from-sky to-coral gradient tile with a ph:cursor-click-bold icon + a font-extrabold 'Button' + 'Studio' wordmark where Studio is text-skyfill); CENTER a 14px text-mute line 'A button design system on the infinite canvas. Built for makers.'; RIGHT a gap-3 row of three text-mute social icon links (ph:github-logo-fill, ph:twitter-logo-fill, ph:figma-logo-fill) that hover to text-sky.

special_ui_components.prompt: One base .b every button shares: font-weight 600, border-radius 9999px (full pill), inline-flex items-center gap .5rem, line-height 1, cursor pointer, user-select none, will-change transform, and the signature springy transition transform .18s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) plus .18s ease on box-shadow/background/color. :focus-visible = outline 3px solid rgba(2,132,199,.65) offset 3px. Hover lifts the button translateY(-3px) (candy also rotate(-1deg)); :active squishes to translateY(0) scale(.97). The bounce is the whole personality.

Six variants, all using DARKENED accessible accent fills so white text clears AA: .b-sky background #0369a1, white text, shadow 0 10px 22px -8px rgba(3,105,161,.55), hover bg #075985; .b-coral background #e11d48, white text, hover bg #be123c; .b-soft background #e0f4fe with #075985 text, hover bg #cdecfd (a pale sky tint, dark-enough text for >=4.5:1); .b-out transparent with #3b3a4a text and inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(59,58,74,.28) ring, hover ring #0284c7 + text #075985; .b-ghost transparent with #57565f text, hover text #3b3a4a on a rgba(59,58,74,.06) wash; .b-candy a 120deg linear-gradient(#0369a1, #e11d48) with white text (both stops darkened so white text stays >=4.5:1 across the whole band), hover adds a -1deg rotate.
.b-sm = padding .55rem 1rem, font-size .8rem; .b-md = padding .8rem 1.5rem, font-size .95rem; .b-lg = padding 1.05rem 2rem, font-size 1.1rem. All stay fully pill-shaped; only padding and type scale.

.b-pressed = a pushed-in look that reads in a static frame, transform translateY(2px) scale(.95), background #075985, box-shadow inset 0 4px 10px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.35) + 0 2px 6px -4px rgba(3,105,161,.5). .b-loading = pointer-events none, paired with a .spin element (animation spin .8s linear infinite, @keyframes spin to rotate 360deg) on a ph:circle-notch-bold icon. .b-disabled = background #e3ded5, text #5c5950, no shadow, cursor not-allowed, transform none (a muted warm-gray any variant can wear).

Under the gradient hero word 'delightful', an absolutely positioned inline SVG (-bottom-2, full width, preserveAspectRatio none) drawing a single hand-drawn curved <path> in coral #fb7185, stroke-width 4, stroke-linecap round, so the highlight word gets a casual marker underline rather than a straight rule.

Icon-only buttons: a .b with !rounded-full !p-3 holding a single Iconify icon, aria-labelled (a soft-tint heart, a coral plus FAB). Segmented group: an inline-flex rounded-full bg-skyfill/15 p-1 bar of three .b-sm buttons, the first a solid sky 'Day' and the rest ghost buttons forced to skyfill text ('Week', 'Month'), the whole pill grouping reading as one toggle control.

Each nav link is .navlink with an ::after pseudo bar (position absolute, left 0, bottom -6px, height 2px, width 0, background sky #38bdf8, border-radius 2px, transition width .25s ease) that grows to width 100% on hover, a playful sky underline sweep.

.dotgrid = a radial-gradient(rgba(59,58,74,0.07) 1.4px, transparent 1.4px) tiled at 22px 22px behind the hero. .blob = filter blur(64px); big rounded color blobs (sky/20, coral/18, amber-200/25) animate gently with .float-a (6s) and .float-b (8s reverse) keyframes translating translateY 0 -> -14px, so the warm pastel atmosphere drifts behind the content.

structured.special_notes: A warm, playful, fully ROUNDED (border-radius 9999px) pastel button system on cream paper, the whole personality is bounce + roundness + soft color. Exact palette via Tailwind config: cream #fdf9f3 (page bg), sky #38bdf8 (DECORATIVE accent only, blobs/rings/underline/selection), skyfill #0369a1 (sky-700, accessible fill for sky buttons + brand text, white text 5.4:1), coral #fb7185 (decorative accent only), coralfill #e11d48 (rose-600, accessible coral fill, white text 4.7:1), ink #3b3a4a (text), mute #6b6a78 (muted body, >=4.5:1). Soft variant = bg #e0f4fe / #075985 text; disabled = bg #e3ded5 / #5c5950 text. Candy gradient = 120deg linear-gradient(#0369a1, #e11d48) (both stops darkened so white text clears AA). Custom shadows: card 0 24px 60px -28px rgba(59,58,74,0.28), soft 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(56,189,248,0.35), coralsoft 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(251,113,133,0.40). Font: Poppins ONLY (Google Fonts 400;500;600;700;800), extrabold headlines + tracking-tight, semibold buttons/labels. Signature motion: springy transition cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), hover translateY(-3px) (candy also rotate(-1deg)), active scale(.97); static .b-pressed pushes in with an inset shadow; .spin loader at .8s. Icons are Iconify ph (phosphor) loaded from code.iconify.design (cursor-click-bold/-fill, sparkle-fill, palette-fill, stack-fill, arrows-out-line-vertical-bold, pulse-bold, hand-pointing-fill, circle-notch-bold, squares-four-fill, download-simple-bold, arrow-right-bold, heart-fill, plus-bold, copy-bold, arrow-up-right-bold, github/twitter/figma-logo-fill). To transfer the STYLE keep the cream+sky+coral pastel palette with darkened accent FILLS for contrast, the full-pill radius, Poppins, the springy bounce/lift/squish motion, the dotted-grid + floating-blob backdrop, the white rounded-[2rem] shadow-card tiles, and the hand-drawn squiggle underline. To transfer the LAYOUT keep the single marketing canvas (sticky blurred nav -> blobby dotted hero with palette chip card -> showcase cards 01 Variants / 02 Sizes + 03 States two-up / 04 Icon & Group, each with an icon-tile + numbered title + count-pill header -> candy-gradient CTA band -> minimal footer) and the labelled 'button above a caption' demo grids. No em-dashes in any copy.
